hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); f=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in *.py) [ -f "$f" ] && ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; true

in=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || f=$(printf '%s' "$in" | python -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); f=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in */.neuroflow/flowie/*) d="${f%%/.neuroflow/*}/.neuroflow/flowie"; [ -d "$d/.git" ] && { git -C "$d" add -A; git -C "$d" reset -q -- integrations.json; git -C "$d" commit -m "sync: auto"; git -C "$d" push; } >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; true
